description: This file defines interfaces for grain storage operations in Orleans, including methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, as well as handling ETags and state existence checks.

classes.name: IStorage
classes.description: Interface for operating on grain storage, providing methods for state management and concurrency control via ETags.

classes.name: IStorage<TState>
classes.description: Generic interface extending IStorage, adding a property for the grain state.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes the grain state to storage.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the grain state from storage.
